name: VCW World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Held three times by one man and all at once by another, and defended live against a touring legend in a twelve-man interfederation gauntlet.

name: VCW Intercontinental Championship
epitaph: Held alongside the World and Six-Man Tag titles by the same monster heel in 1996.

name: VCW Six-Man Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Held in 1996 by a three-belt monster heel alongside unnamed partners no surviving document identifies.

name: VCW Light Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Held by a wrestler the community itself ranked #14 in its own Top 75 of 1995.
